motor.why: 5203-2402-0001 (vendor), HTD 16T:24T to the flywheel; the squishy wheel geared off the same shaft

angle.why: tips: rigid at the command (floating parts, servo not modelled)

squish.why: the ball pressed between the squishy wheel and the bore's front wall, rolling up it at its own rolling speed

hood_mech.why: turret v3 step 4 hood toggle, the model of turret_v3_mech.py (Rig.run) ported to js/shooter.js HoodMech; labels as there

variant.label: One hood v3, middle curvature (adopted 2026-11-03): full CAD + hood mechanism
variant.describe: Turret v3 step 4: the FULL CAD, drawn on the bodies it moves with (export_v3_cad_scene.py; drawn only except the hood's mechanism). Frame: the ring with its 2 NECTAR teeth, plywood plates, shafts and bearings, 5203 motor and its end cup, HTD and GT2 belts and pulleys, plate tie, 3208 swivel, hood servo, crankshaft, fixings. Hood: the one-print hood on its 4 rollers, the angle servo on its B rail. The moving hood teeth (orange) turn with the angle slider and the herringbone angle pinion turns with them. The hood MOVES ON ITS REAL MECHANISM (export_v3_mech_scene.py, the model of turret_v3_mech.py): a free planar body guided only by its rollers in the plates' hook slots (contacts, rolling friction 0.01), driven by the 25-2 Torque servo as a DC motor behind its position loop through the 34T/52T gears (0.28 mm backlash, tooth friction), the crank and the 41.3 mm link (pin friction); POLLEN = the servo commanded past the seat to press the hood in with its 1.12 N m preload, NECTAR 0.57. The ball's loads act on this mechanism every shot. Contact model underneath (what the ball touches): 1 Hogback(s) + 6 steel discs (bottom forward, HTD 16:16), the feed's top squishy wheel geared 1:4 off the flywheel motor, the short bore ring (one part with the NECTAR rails, which ride a crowned 4 mm band at constant radius), the concave POLLEN hood (out 22 mm for NECTAR) with its curved entry piece, and comb-finger tips about the axle (angle slider = exit 50-85 deg). Each ball starts squeezed between the squishy and the ring, rolling up.
variant.describe_contact: Ben's 2026-10-21 topspin under-wrap turret, ONLY the parts that touch the ball, floating: 1 Hogback(s) + 6 steel discs (bottom forward, HTD 16:16), the feed's top squishy wheel geared 1:4 off the flywheel motor, the short bore ring (one part with the NECTAR rails, which ride a crowned 4 mm band at constant radius), the concave POLLEN hood (out 22 mm for NECTAR) with its curved entry piece, and comb-finger tips about the axle (angle slider = exit 50-85 deg). Each ball starts squeezed between the squishy and the ring, rolling up.

parts.name: flywheel
parts.note: 1 goBILDA Hogback(s) 96 x 24

parts.name: squishy
parts.note: team cast 3.5 in squishy, sprung rim segments

parts.name: ring + NECTAR teeth
parts.note: short bore ring, flat top; 2 fixed NECTAR entry teeth between the hood's

parts.name: hood
parts.note: ONE trough for both balls (NECTAR-sized section, POLLEN arc): 3 teeth from the ring edge to the exit fingers

parts.name: tips
parts.note: 2 comb-finger teeth on the hood, about its axle point

parts.name: motor_cup_screws
parts.note: 4 x M4 x 14 button heads through plate B into the cup's captured nuts + 1 x M4 x 35 clamp screw + nyloc

parts.name: motor_cup
parts.note: MOTOR CUP (PETG): flange on plate B's inner face (4 x M4 x 14 from outside into captured nuts), a sleeve gripping the can (split, 1 x M4 x 35 clamp + nyloc), a 14 mm slot on top: the motor's 3 leads leave its end cap and turn up through it

parts.name: crank_shaft
parts.note: THE FRONT TIE: ONE 8 mm REX shaft (167 mm, cut a goBILDA 2106) across the gap in a 1611 in each plate (flanges outside), a goBILDA 2910 collar outside each: the yoke (gear + arm B, REX bores, bosses out to the bearings) turns with it

parts.name: servo_screws
parts.note: 4 x M4 x 12 button heads through the hood servo's ears + plate A, nylocs outside

parts.name: angle_screws
parts.note: 4 x M4 x 16 button heads through the servo's ears + the 6 mm fin, nylocs

parts.name: angle_pinion
parts.note: ANGLE PINION (PETG): 19T MOD 2 herringbone, 30 deg helix, 9.5 mm, 14 mm bore on the hub's boss

parts.name: angle_hub
parts.note: goBILDA 1906-0025-0032 servo hub + 4 x M4 x 12 button heads through the 9.5 mm pinion (2.5 mm into its thread; longer hits the case)

parts.name: angle_servo
parts.note: ANGLE SERVO: goBILDA 2000-0025-0003 (25-3 Speed) on the hood's fin, 4 x M4 x 16 button heads + nylocs (slots set the mesh); 7.37:1, 258 deg for exit 50-85; set its spline so servo mid = exit 67.5

parts.name: hood_teeth
parts.note: MOVING TEETH (PETG, one print): lanes 1 + 3 + the joined 30 mm lead-out, a T-head on each back, the 140T-pitch MOD 2 herringbone sector on the B-side arm with a solid END STOP block at each end (the pinion meets it 1.9 deg past exit 85 / 1.9 past exit 50). Turns +-17.5 deg about the hood centre

parts.name: hood
parts.note: HOOD (PETG, one print): 3 static teeth, 2 cheeks with the 4 roller bosses (captured M5 nylocs), the link clevis, the bridge and 2 arc rails (R 139.3) with T-slots open at the front (the teeth slide in there), the angle servo's cradle (deck, fin with 1 mm slotted holes, lip), a zip-tie block on the bridge's back for the angle servo's lead

parts.name: fixings
parts.note: ring ears -> plates 4 x M4 x 16 (captured nuts in the ears); motor face 4 x M4 x 10 button heads (heads under the HTD pulley, 1.8 mm clear); ring -> gear 4 x M4 x 18 socket heads (+4 if the holes are tapped)

parts.name: toggle_pinion
parts.note: TOGGLE PINION (PETG): 34T MOD 1, 15 mm wide, 14 mm bore on the hub's boss, 4 x M4 x 18 into the hub (simulated: the hood's toggle)

parts.name: servo_hub
parts.note: goBILDA 1906-0025-0032 servo hub on the hood servo + 4 x M4 x 18 button heads through the 15 mm pinion (3 mm into its thread) (simulated: the hood's toggle)

parts.name: toggle_servo
parts.note: HOOD SERVO: goBILDA 2000-0025-0002 (25-2 Torque, 300 deg, dual ball-bearing output), ears on plate A's inner face, body out through the window, 4 x M4 x 12 button heads + nylocs; no ServoBlock (default: preload pushes the output ~23 N sideways)

parts.name: toggle_pins
parts.note: HOOD PIN: ISO 7379 6 x 20 shoulder screw (M5) through the clevis lugs + link, DIN 125 6.4 washer under the head, M5 nyloc

parts.name: link
parts.note: LINK (PETG, 6 mm): 41.3 mm between pins, knee tube -> the hood's clevis pin

parts.name: knee_rod
parts.note: KNEE: 10 x 1 mm aluminium tube 74.7 mm long (cut) between the 2 arms, the link rides on it; M5 x 100 socket head through arm B, the tube and the gear into an M5 nyloc in the gear's pocket: clamps the yoke into one piece (simulated: the hood's toggle)

parts.name: crank_arm
parts.note: YOKE ARM (PETG, plate B side): crank arm, REX bore + a 12 mm REX boss out to plate B's bearing; the knee bolt's hole (simulated: the hood's toggle)

parts.name: crank_gear
parts.note: YOKE GEAR (PETG): 52T MOD 1, 15 mm wide, REX bore + a 12 mm REX boss out to plate A's bearing (it turns with the shaft); the knee bolt's hole + its nyloc pocket. Swings 79 deg = 120 deg of the hood servo (simulated: the hood's toggle)

parts.name: rail_screws
parts.note: 4 x ISO 7379 6 x 10 shoulder screws (M5) from outside into M5 nylocs captured in the hood's roller bosses (slide each nut in from the boss's side); plate A: 18 mm washer outside + shim rings so flange-to-washer = the plate + 0.1; plate B: 12 mm washers

parts.name: rail_bearings
parts.note: 4 x F686ZZ flanged bearings (6 x 13 x 5, flange 15) rolling in the plates' 13.1 mm hook slots; plate A's flanges locate the hood

parts.name: swivel
parts.note: goBILDA 3208-0004-0001 gear-driven turret (105 mm bore, 64T gear, 2.75:1); its gear's top = the turret's base plane

parts.name: tie
parts.note: BACK TIE: goBILDA 1516-4008-1200 (120 mm) + 1516-4008-0120 (12 mm) 8 mm REX standoffs joined by an M4 x 8 set screw = 132 mm, 2 x M4 x 10 button heads through the plates (goBILDA sells no 128-136 mm standoff)

parts.name: collars
parts.note: 4 x goBILDA 2910-0920-4008 clamping collars (8 mm REX, 20 OD, 9 mm) on the squishy shaft: outside plate A's bearing, outside the pulley, and one against each squishy flange (they set the wheel's place: centre it)

parts.name: gt2_belt
parts.note: GT2 6 mm closed belt, 420 mm (210T): fits 159.42 mm centres with 79T (needs 159.39)

parts.name: gt2_pulley
parts.note: SQUISHY PULLEY (PETG): GT2 79T, REX bore, 2 flanges + a boss onto the bearing's inner ring (3 mm); 20T/79T = 1:3.95 (squishy 1.3 % faster than 1:4) so a standard belt fits

parts.name: gt2_20t
parts.note: GT2 20T pulley, 8 mm bore, 6 mm belt, ~16 mm long (generic; goBILDA 3422-4008-0020 is sold out): on the flywheel shaft outside plate B, 2 set screws on the REX flats

parts.name: fly_spacers
parts.note: 2 x goBILDA 1522 8 mm ID x 10 OD spacers on the flywheel shaft: 3 mm (A, behind the HTD pulley) + 3 mm (B, behind the 20T): the pulleys' set screws pull them onto the bearings' inner rings

parts.name: htd_belt
parts.note: goBILDA 3412-0009-0320 HTD 5M belt, 9 wide, 320 mm (64T): exact at the 120.0 mm centres

parts.name: htd_pulleys
parts.note: 2 x goBILDA 3417-4008-0016 HTD 5M 16T pulleys (motor -> flywheel 1:1), outside plate A, both at X 76.35-88.35: the motor's sits 1.8 mm clear of its face screw heads (set by its set screws, line it up with the flywheel's)

parts.name: motor
parts.note: goBILDA 5203-2402-0001 Yellow Jacket 6000 rpm between the plates, face on plate A (4 x M4 x 10 button heads from outside), shaft out through it; leads leave its back end cap (bullets + JST XH) through the motor cup's top slot

parts.name: squishy_screws
parts.note: 3 x M3 x 50 socket heads + 3 x M3 nylocs

parts.name: squishy_flange
parts.note: SQUISHY FLANGES (PETG, 2 identical): REX bore (the shaft drives the wheel through them), a boss into the wheel's bore, a 40 mm disc (NECTAR squashes the wheel to r ~22.6 there); 3 x M3 x 50 socket heads sunk in one, M3 nylocs in the other's pockets

parts.name: bearings
parts.note: 4 x goBILDA 1611-0514-4008 flanged bearings (8 mm REX, 14 OD x 5), flange on the plate's OUTER face, in 14.0 mm holes (cut a coupon first)

parts.name: sq_shaft
parts.note: 8 mm REX shaft, 181 mm (cut a goBILDA 2106 REX shaft)

parts.name: fly_shaft
parts.note: 8 mm REX shaft, 182 mm (cut a goBILDA 2106 REX shaft)

parts.name: fly_screws
parts.note: 16 x M4 x 25 thread-forming socket heads, 8 a side through the 3 discs into the Hogback's 3.3 mm holes (goBILDA: 12 mm for one disc, + 12 for the 2 more; CHECK the counterbore depth)

parts.name: fly_hub
parts.note: goBILDA 1309-0016-4008 Sonic Hub (8 mm REX, 32 mm) inside the Hogback's rim, on its web: 4 x M4 x 10 through the web into the hub; its 2 clamp screws grip the shaft (they also set the pack's place along it: centre it)

parts.name: plate_b
parts.note: PLATE B (1/4 in black acetal): the same bearings, slots and ties; the motor cup's 4 holes; 2 x 4.2 zip-tie holes for the angle servo's lead; no windows

parts.name: plate_a
parts.note: PLATE A (1/4 in black acetal, laser cut): 3 x 1611 bearing holes 14.0, the motor face (4 x M4 on r 11.31) + 18 mm shaft hole, the toggle servo window + ears, the 2 hook slots 13.1 (cut a coupon first: 13.0/13.1/13.2 slots, 13.9/14.0/14.1 holes)

parts.name: ring
parts.note: RING (PETG): the bore + 2 NECTAR teeth (testbench contact faces) + 2 side ears + 2 back lugs. Each ear: 2 x M4 x 18 socket heads down into the 3208's threaded +-8 mm holes (X 56.0), 2 x M4 x 16 along X from the plate into captured nuts. Lugs + NECTAR teeth: 4 more M4 into holes the 3208 STEP draws plain (fit them only if tapped).
